test_title: PYST 10: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00aa4b0506c5dd8ea009a506a240588911e7312f1ea196e09bccd3e59fefdf88.png]
solution:
The figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series is as shown below :

 
• First position line with a symbol rotates 180⁰ and moves to fourth position from figure to figure.
 
• Second position line moves to first position, Third position line moves to second position, Fourth position lines moves to third position from figure to figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec61c6528c6220204554ae8f51d0f41be5339ccb688d76ebe3071ce85ed312b6.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
